_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Arma Reforger egg in https://github.com/pelican-eggs/games-steamcmd (MIT).
name: Arma Reforger
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Bohemia's Cold War military sandbox, with Conflict and Game Master scenarios. Installs the dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated.
startup: if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update {{SRCDS_APPID}} ${SRCDS_BETAID:+-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID"} ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:+-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS"} $([ "{{VALIDATE}}" = 1 ] && echo validate) +quit || echo "Steam couldn't update the game, so the server starts as it is."; fi; if jq --arg v "{{VISIBLE}}" --arg b "{{BATTLEYE}}" --arg t "{{DISABLE_THIRD}}" --arg c "{{CROSS_PLATFORM}}" --arg r "$RCON_PASSWORD" --arg rp "{{RCON_PORT}}" '.game.visible = ($v == "true") | .game.gameProperties.battlEye = ($b == "true") | .game.gameProperties.disableThirdPerson = ($t == "true") | .game.crossPlatform = ($c == "true") | .game.supportedPlatforms = (if $c == "true" then ["PLATFORM_PC","PLATFORM_XBL","PLATFORM_PSN"] else ["PLATFORM_PC"] end) | if $r == "" then del(.rcon) else .rcon = ((.rcon // {}) + {address: "0.0.0.0", port: ($rp | tonumber), password: $r, permission: (.rcon.permission // "admin")}) end' config.json > config.json.new; then mv -f config.json.new config.json; else rm -f config.json.new; echo "config.json isn't valid JSON, so the server starts with it as it is."; fi; ./ArmaReforgerServer -config ./config.json -profile ./profile -addonTempDir ./tmp -backendlog -nothrow -maxFPS {{MAX_FPS}} $([ "{{LOG_INTERVAL}}" -gt 0 ] && echo -logStats $(({{LOG_INTERVAL}} * 1000))) $([ "{{CRASH_REPORTS}}" = true ] || echo -disableCrashReporter) 2>&1 | (trap '' INT TERM; while IFS= read -r l; do printf '%s\n' "$l"; case "$l" in *'Replication finished.'*) (sleep 10; kill 0) & ;; esac; done)

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Arma Reforger. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 1874900) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously.
# Saves, mods and config.json are never replaced.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-1874900}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# config.json is written once; the Panel sets the ports, name, passwords,
# scenario and player count in it at every start, and the startup the
# true/false settings and RCON. Mods, admins and the rest are the owner's.
mkdir -p profile
if [ ! -f config.json ]; then
    cat > config.json <<'EOF'
{
    "bindAddress": "",
    "bindPort": 2001,
    "publicAddress": "",
    "publicPort": 2001,
    "a2s": {
        "address": "0.0.0.0",
        "port": 17777
    },
    "game": {
        "name": "An Arma Reforger server",
        "password": "",
        "passwordAdmin": "",
        "admins": [],
        "scenarioId": "{ECC61978EDCC2B5A}Missions/23_Campaign.conf",
        "maxPlayers": 32,
        "visible": true,
        "crossPlatform": false,
        "supportedPlatforms": ["PLATFORM_PC"],
        "gameProperties": {
            "serverMaxViewDistance": 2500,
            "serverMinGrassDistance": 50,
            "networkViewDistance": 1000,
            "disableThirdPerson": false,
            "fastValidation": true,
            "battlEye": true,
            "VONDisableUI": false,
            "VONDisableDirectSpeechUI": false
        },
        "mods": []
    },
    "operating": {
        "lobbyPlayerSynchronise": true
    }
}
EOF
    echo "Made config.json."
fi
echo "Installed Arma Reforger build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The password that makes a player an admin in game (#login), with no spaces; empty for none.

variables.name: Scenario
variables.description: The scenario's ID, such as {ECC61978EDCC2B5A}Missions/23_Campaign.conf (Conflict on Everon); the server lists the others when it starts.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Visible
variables.description: List the server in the in-game server browser (true or false).

variables.name: BattlEye
variables.description: Run the BattlEye anti-cheat, which every player then needs (true or false).

variables.name: Disable third person
variables.description: Keep players in first person (true or false).

variables.name: Crossplay
variables.description: Let Xbox and PlayStation players join as well (true or false); every mod must then be available on consoles.

variables.name: Query port
variables.description: The port Steam's server queries use; give it an allocation.

variables.name: RCON port
variables.description: The port for remote admin tools (BattlEye RCON); give it an allocation to use it.

variables.name: RCON password
variables.description: The password for remote admin tools, at least 3 characters without spaces; empty turns RCON off.

variables.name: Max FPS
variables.description: The server's frame limit; Bohemia recommends 60 to 120, and higher uses more CPU.

variables.name: Stats interval
variables.description: How often, in seconds, the server logs its FPS and player stats to the console; 0 turns it off.

variables.name: Crash reports
variables.description: Send crash reports to Bohemia Interactive (true or false).

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
